promptState.text: The woman from <Picture 1> now wears the brown leather jacket from <Picture 2> over her red dress, worn open at the front, so the red dress shows between the two open fronts and below the hem of the jacket, which ends just below her waist. The jacket keeps its look from <Picture 2>: worn dark brown leather with a soft sheen and creases at the elbows, a pointed collar, a silver metal zip, two slanted side pockets and a black lining. Its sleeves reach her wrists and cover the sleeves of the dress. She stands exactly as in <Picture 1>, in the same framing from the top of her head to her shins, her right arm relaxed at her side and her left hand resting on her hip. She now stands on a city pavement on an autumn afternoon: grey stone paving under her feet, a row of old red-brick shopfronts with tall windows and dark green awnings behind her, softly out of focus, and a few yellow leaves on the ground. Warm, low sunlight from camera-left falls across her face, her hair and the leather of the jacket, with soft shade on the far side of her face. Keep her face, her long wavy blonde hair, her gold earrings and the red dress exactly as they are in <Picture 1>. A clean, high-resolution photograph from a full-frame camera with a 50mm lens at f/2.8, with smooth, even tonal gradations in the skin and fine natural detail.

MODELS AND NODES USED IN THIS WORKFLOW

 MiniMax H3 Image needs ComfyUI 0.45.0 or newer, the first version with these nodes. On an older ComfyUI the nodes show red: update ComfyUI first.

 Load Diffusion Model

Download minimax_h3_image_pruned_int8_convrot.safetensors19.5 GB  

Place in: ComfyUI/models/diffusion_models/h3

Create the h3 folder if it does not exist.

 Load CLIP

Download qwen3vl_32b_minimax_h3_nvfp4_awq.safetensors14.6 GB  

Place in: ComfyUI/models/text_encoders

The same text encoder as MiniMax H3 video: if you did Episode 41 you already have it.

 Load VAE

Download minimax_h3_image_vae_fp16.safetensors1.09 GB  

Place in: ComfyUI/models/vae

 License

MiniMax H3 Image has its own license, the MiniMax-H3-Image Community License, separate from the MiniMax H3 video license. Read it and check what it says for your country before you use the model: some countries need a license from MiniMax first.

READ LICENSE MiniMax H3 Image model page 

 After placing the files, restart ComfyUI or refresh model lists using the R shortcut.

 Nodes Installed from Manager

  • Pixaroma: update to the latest version (these workflows need at least 1.4.183). A node shows red or missing? Update Pixaroma.

Which version is the newest? The Latest Pixaroma version button shows it and what is new in it. The help page has the update steps for every kind of install.

Latest Pixaroma version How to update Pixaroma 

 Something missing?

Each button opens a short video that shows the fix, with the steps written under it.

Red or missing nodes A model file is missing Buttons missing after an update 

 Resources

Join Discord  Pixaroma YouTube Channel  Ask for help

HOW TO USE

Give MiniMax H3 Image two pictures and say how to combine them. The demo puts the leather jacket from the second picture on the woman from the first, and moves her to an autumn street.

 Steps

  1. Load the person in the first Load Image Mini Pixaroma (1). The result takes the shape of this picture.
  2. Load the outfit, or whatever you want to bring in, in the second one (2).
  3. Write how to combine them in Prompt Pixaroma: <Picture 1> is the first picture, <Picture 2> the second.
  4. Click a size on Number Pick Pixaroma: 16 megapixels is the demo, 4 and 8 are faster.
  5. Leave the seed on F to repeat a result, or switch it to R to try a new one every Run.
  6. Press Run. Drag across Image Compare Pixaroma to see before and after.

 Writing the prompt

  1. Say who takes what from where: The woman from <Picture 1> now wears the brown leather jacket from <Picture 2> over her red dress.
  2. Say how the new thing sits: worn open at the front, ends just below her waist, its sleeves reach her wrists.
  3. Name its details, so they come through: a pointed collar, a silver metal zip, two slanted side pockets and a black lining.
  4. Give the pose and the framing in your own words: her right arm relaxed at her side and her left hand resting on her hip.
  5. Then the new place and the light, and end with what to keep: Keep her face, her long wavy blonde hair, her gold earrings and the red dress exactly as they are.

 Good to know

  • The first picture leads. The result takes its shape and size from it, so for a character in a new place, load the place first.
  • In all four test seeds she wore the jacket open over the dress, in the same pose. Her face changed a little with the seed: on two of them she looked a few years older. Compare faces at full size and try a few seeds.
  • Write the change out, like the demo. A one-line request failed in workflow 3's tests.
  • Two pictures take longer than one: about 37 seconds at 16 megapixels. See Run Times.

 Something not working?

Each button opens the answer on the Pixaroma help page.

Save to your own folder Nodes look different from the video

{"version":1,"content":"

WHAT EACH NODE DOES

The colour of a node tells you what kind of node it is. Nothing here needs changing except the blue ones.

 Models to download

Orange. Each one needs a file from the Download Models note.

  • Load Diffusion Model (MiniMax H3 Image) - MiniMax H3 Image, the picture model made by MiniMax itself. It is a different file from the H3 video models of Episode 41 and from P-H3 Image of Episode 42.
  • Load CLIP (MiniMax H3 text encoder) - Reads your prompt. It is the same Qwen3-VL 32B text encoder as MiniMax H3 video, so if you did Episode 41 you already have it. The type must be minimax.
  • Load VAE (MiniMax H3 Image VAE) - Turns the finished render into the picture. It is made for MiniMax H3 Image, a different file from the H3 video VAE and the P-H3 Image VAE.

 The steps you set

Blue, and numbered. These are the only nodes you need to touch.

  • Load Image Mini Pixaroma (1. the person) - The first picture, <Picture 1> in the prompt: the person, or whatever the result is built around. The result takes its shape. Click it to upload your own, or pick one from the list.
  • Load Image Mini Pixaroma (2. the outfit) - The second picture, <Picture 2> in the prompt: the clothes, a character, a place, whatever you want to bring in.
  • Prompt Pixaroma (3. how to combine them) - Say what goes where, using <Picture 1> and <Picture 2>, then what to keep (see How to Use).
  • Number Pick Pixaroma (4. megapixels) - How big the result is. Click 4, 8 or 16 (the demo) megapixels. The result takes the shape of the first picture: the demo goes in at 1080 x 1920 and comes out at 3072 x 5472. A smaller size is faster.
  • Seed Pixaroma (5. fixed or random) - The seed. F (fixed) repeats the result, R (random) tries a new one every Run. The demo uses seed 2.

 The work

Green. They run by themselves.

  • Scale Image to Total Pixels (scales your picture) - Scales your picture to the size you clicked on Number Pick Pixaroma, on the model's 32 pixel grid.
  • Get Image Size (the size of the result) - Reads the size of the scaled picture and hands it to the conditioning, so the result comes out that big. Without it the result would stop at 2048 pixels on its short side.
  • MiniMax H3 Image Conditioning (prompt + your two pictures) - Joins the prompt, your two pictures and the size from Get Image Size. The first picture goes in at the size you clicked, the second as it is. The VAE wire anchors both pictures in full detail; without it the model sees them only through the text encoder.
  • ConditioningZeroOut (no negative prompt) - An empty negative. The model takes no negative prompt, and CFG stays at 1.
  • KSampler (6 steps, CFG 1) - The render: 6 steps, CFG 1, euler and simple, as MiniMax made the model. In our tests 10 steps made skin worse, and the er_sde sampler made it noisy, so leave these as they are.
  • VAE Decode (latent to picture) - Turns the finished render into a picture.

 The result

Dark red, at the end.

  • Save Image Pixaroma (saves the result) - Saves each result as PNG into ComfyUI/output/MiniMax H3 Image Combine and shows it on the node.
  • Image Compare Pixaroma (before and after, drag across it) - The first picture and the result on top of each other. Drag across it to see what changed and what stayed.

 Readouts

Dark. Nothing to set: they show you what happened.

  • Run Timer - The dark clock above the result shows how long the last Run took.

","buttonColor":"#f66744","lineColor":"#f66744","backgroundColor":"#2a2a2a","info":{"title":"Nodes Info","icon":"node-v5","color":"#3d7cc9"}}

RUN TIMES

Measured on a 24 GB RTX 4090 with this workflow, with the models already loaded. A different card gives different numbers, but the shape holds: a smaller picture is faster.

SizeTime
4 megapixelsabout 14 s
8 megapixelsabout 32 s
16 megapixels (the demo)about 37 s

 The first Run of the session

The first Run after starting ComfyUI also has to load the models (about 35 GB: 19.5 GB for the model, 14.6 GB for the text encoder and 1 GB for the VAE), so it takes longer. After that they stay in memory, if your PC has enough of it.

 On a smaller card

Click 4 or 8 on Number Pick Pixaroma.

","buttonColor":"#f66744","lineColor":"#f66744","backgroundColor":"#2a2a2a","info":{"title":"Run Times","icon":"run-timer","color":"#3f9a4f"}}
